passages.text: Movement and rest, life and death, rise and fall, are not at the beck and call of man. Cultivation of self is in his own hands.
passages.note: Accepting what we cannot control; working on ourselves

passages.text: Are you not one who extends his learning with a view to being a Sage; who talks big in order to put himself above the rest of mankind; who plays in a key to which no one can sing so as to spread his reputation abroad? Rather become unconscious of self and shake off the trammels of the flesh,--and you will be near. But if you cannot govern your own self, what leisure have you for governing the empire?
